ARCS kitMolecule 59claim-check

Claim Check

Set what someone said beside what the record shows, with a state chip, so a reader sees at once which claims hold, which drifted, which are unchecked and which slipped.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1SaidWho said it and when (mono, label step), then the claim as quotedtext-secondary, text
2State chip28 Chip: Sharp (green, proven), Degraded (gold, right size and wrong unit), Unchecked (plain), Slip (red, failed)green, gold, plain, red
3ValueWhat the record shows, mono at the headline step, in the state colour--fs-headline
4NoteOne line on the gaptext-secondary
5Source32 Evidence ref: the command or file that checked itdimmed
6Fidelity37 classes on the row: sharp, degraded, grain (unchecked) set the weightnone

Usage

Use it when

  • A call or a page made factual claims that can be checked against a record (git, a catalog, a source).
  • The reader needs to know what to correct before writing anything down.

Do not use it when

  • Do not mark an unchecked claim red; red is only for a claim the record contradicts.
  • Do not use it for opinions; a take is 60 Heat take.
  • Colour has one meaning across the kit (arc weld spec 4.3): red a failed check, gold a limit, green proven, cyan an action or focus, plain (steel) unknown, magenta a paradox.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
claims[]{who, at, said, state, value, note, ref}yesstate is sharp, degraded, grain or slip.

Access

  • Source order is said, state, record, so a screen reader reads the claim before the verdict.
  • The chip names the state in words; colour repeats it, never replaces it.
  • One column below 38rem; three from 38rem.
